collection.title: Abarth Punto Evo 2010 to 2015 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Abarth Punto Evo 2010 - 2015 model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 15" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Pinch Tab arm attachment. We also have rear blade for this Abarth Punto Evo, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
